coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items match: JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware resources, MAPPO versus QMIX as primary algorithms, and wall-clock time to a defined performance threshold. Seconds rather than minutes is a convertible reporting difference.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design selects only three maps rather than the required nine maps selected by excluding maps with more than 10 units. Its normalized score subtracts a random baseline and divides by an expert-minus-random baseline, rather than dividing the algorithm score by the scenario maximum.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It omits both expected findings: PPO trains approximately 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios due to better training stability and policy optimization.
